# catalyst_stratus_object (Resource)

Manage an object in an existing unversioned Stratus bucket. Uploads local bytes and content type, supports in-place content updates, import, SHA-256 drift detection and confirmed deletion. This provider limits files to 100 MB; multipart uploads, versioned keys, TTL and custom metadata are not supported. The object key must belong exclusively to this resource; do not use keys with version history. Destroy permanently removes the managed key using the Stratus object deletion API. Creation checks absence and uses overwrite=false; an existing key requires explicit import. Temporary bucket signatures remain in memory and never enter Terraform state or diagnostics; transfers are restricted to the expected regional Stratus origin and do not forward OAuth headers. Source contents are not stored in state. Requires bucket read and object read/create/delete scopes. Import with project_id/bucket_name/object_key, retaining slashes in nested keys; then supply a matching local source/hash/content type. Live validation is limited to India Development.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Existing Catalyst project ID."
}
variable "bucket_name" {
  type        = string
  description = "Existing unversioned Stratus bucket name."
}
variable "object_source" {
  type        = string
  description = "Path to an existing local file, up to 100 MB."
}
resource "catalyst_stratus_object" "example" {
  project_id    = var.project_id
  bucket_name   = var.bucket_name
  key           = "assets/example.bin"
  source        = var.object_source
  source_sha256 = filesha256(var.object_source)
  content_type  = "application/octet-stream"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Existing unversioned bucket's lowercase DNS name.
- `key` (String) Object key, up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Nested paths are supported; absolute paths, dot segments, control characters and backslashes are rejected.
- `project_id` (String) Existing project ID.
- `source` (String) Local regular file, up to 100 MB. Build or prepare it before applying.
- `source_sha256` (String) Lowercase hex SHA-256, usually filesha256(source). Refresh downloads bytes to detect changes independently of ETag.

### Optional

- `content_type` (String) Canonical MIME content type; defaults to application/octet-stream.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) Opaque ETag returned by Stratus; source_sha256 verifies actual content.
- `id` (String) Composite project_id/bucket_name/object_key identity.
- `size` (Number) Remote object size in bytes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import catalyst_stratus_object.example 'PROJECT_ID/BUCKET_NAME/assets/example.bin'
```
